description:
The ultimate representative of the “herbivore type,” pure-hearted pushover Baek Eunwoo VS the apex predator of the “carnivore type,” icy and intimidating Beom Hoyeon.

How in the world did two complete opposites end up dating?

“Baek Eunwoo. Come work for me. Pretend to be my boyfriend. For exactly one year. I’ll pay you… 100 million won.”

Hoyeon, the notoriously devilish director of a top artist residency program, needed a fake boyfriend. Right on cue, Eunwoo appeared in front of her— pretty, poor, and painfully kind.
Seeing her chance, Hoyeon pounced like a predator snatching prey. Overwhelmed by her force, Eunwoo accepts before he can process what’s happening.

But every moment spent with Hoyeon is a struggle for Eunwoo, a lifelong virgin with no dating experience,
while she, with her stunningly beautiful face, speaks and acts shamelessly without hesitation.

Thus begins their clumsy and chaotic fake relationship—
between an innocent boy who has no idea how to handle any of this and a bulldozer of a woman who stops at nothing.

Will they manage to pull off the act of being a crazy-in-love couple who can’t live without each other?

Or will this become a full-color record of a hot and explosive year?
